client-delivery.description: Project outcomes, client relationships, and delivery excellence.

criteria.text: Delivers measurable business outcomes for clients, tracked against agreed success metrics such as cost reduction, revenue growth, or operational efficiency gains.
Defines and monitors key performance indicators at the project level, ensuring the team can demonstrate tangible value delivered at each milestone.
Drives delivery of outcomes that are directly attributable to the engagement, presenting quantified results in executive-level communications and close-out reports.
Builds and sustains trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-suite and VP-level sponsors, ensuring alignment on priorities and long-term partnership health.
Engages a broad coalition of client stakeholders — spanning business, technology, and operations — to build consensus and remove cross-functional blockers during delivery.
Maintains visibility with client decision-makers between project milestones, proactively surfacing insights and recommendations that strengthen the advisory relationship.
Sets the standard for delivery quality on engagements, proactively managing risks, escalating issues appropriately, and communicating status with clarity and confidence.
Creates a culture of accountability and continuous improvement within the delivery team, modeling the behaviors expected of a senior practitioner in high-stakes client environments.
Acts as the primary escalation point for delivery challenges, making decisive trade-off decisions and communicating them clearly to both the client and the internal team.
Aligns the delivery approach with client strategic priorities and long-term objectives, ensuring that project scope and execution choices reflect the client's broader transformation agenda.
Connects individual workstream decisions to overarching program goals and client strategic initiatives, preventing delivery drift and ensuring coherent value realization.
Advises clients on how to sequence initiatives and prioritize investments in a way that maximizes strategic return and minimizes organizational disruption.
Contributes to client account growth through excellence in delivery and relationship stewardship, creating conditions for expanded scopes of work and repeat engagement.
Ensures that delivered solutions are adopted and embedded within client operations, increasing the durability and ROI of the engagement's outputs.
Identifies and communicates follow-on opportunities during delivery, helping to translate successful project outcomes into a pipeline of future engagements with the client.

leadership.description: Team leadership, mentoring, influence, and culture.

criteria.text: Develops team members through structured coaching, mentoring, and stretch assignments, with visible improvement in their performance ratings, scope of responsibility, or promotion outcomes.
Reduces team attrition or improves engagement survey scores through deliberate investment in team culture, career development, and inclusive practices.
Accelerates the onboarding and ramp time of new team members by establishing clear expectations, structured mentorship, and scalable enablement resources.
Influences and aligns cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders toward shared goals, often without direct authority, through credibility and consistent follow-through.
Extends leadership impact beyond immediate teams by mentoring practitioners across practice areas, offices, or capability communities.
Builds relationships with internal and external leaders to shape the direction of people programs, capability investments, and career development frameworks.
Models inclusive leadership behaviors and creates psychological safety within teams, ensuring every team member can contribute, challenge assumptions, and grow.
Provides candid, constructive feedback regularly — both upward and downward — demonstrating the courage and care expected at the Sr. Principal level.
Navigates ambiguity and organizational complexity with composure, setting a stable and confident tone that enables the team to remain focused and productive.
Translates organizational strategy into clear team direction and measurable objectives, ensuring every team member understands how their work connects to firm and client goals.
Aligns talent development investments with the capability gaps most critical to the firm's strategic growth areas, prioritizing mentorship and hiring accordingly.
Participates in succession planning and talent strategy conversations at the practice or market level, contributing data and observations about emerging leaders.
Builds high-performing teams that consistently deliver results, retain top talent, and are recognized as a competitive differentiator in client and market conversations.
Produces future leaders — practitioners who have grown under direct sponsorship and gone on to take on expanded roles, accounts, or responsibilities.
Improves team delivery capacity and quality through leadership investment, resulting in measurably better client satisfaction scores or project outcomes on mentored engagements.

business-development.description: Pipeline contribution, proposals, and market presence.

criteria.text: Contributes to measurable pipeline growth through proactive opportunity identification, qualification, and pursuit — with tracked influence on won revenue or expanded engagements.
Authors or contributes to proposals and statements of work that demonstrate clear commercial value, with a visible win rate relative to the number of pursuits supported.
Generates qualified leads or expands existing account scope through relationship-driven conversations, converting advisory credibility into new revenue opportunities.
Engages prospective and existing clients at the executive level to identify and qualify new business opportunities, maintaining consistent visibility and advisory presence.
Builds a broad network of internal and external relationships — including alliance partners, industry peers, and client sponsors — that generate referrals and collaborative pursuits.
Represents the firm at industry events, conferences, or client roundtables, establishing a credible market presence that supports brand recognition and business development.
Leads or substantially contributes to proposal development and competitive positioning, marshaling the right team resources and shaping a compelling value narrative.
Coaches and supports junior practitioners in developing their business development skills — including client conversation techniques, proposal writing, and opportunity qualification.
Demonstrates persistence and creative problem-solving in pursuit situations, adapting approach based on client feedback and competitive intelligence.
Pursues opportunities that are directly aligned with the firm's strategic priorities, growth areas, and target client profiles — avoiding scope drift into low-fit engagements.
Connects client needs to the firm's differentiated capabilities and point-of-view assets, positioning proposals around strategic value rather than commodity delivery.
Collaborates with practice and market leaders to ensure business development activities reinforce the firm's positioning in priority industries and capability domains.
Converts identified opportunities into won engagements and expanded client relationships, contributing meaningfully to the market's revenue and growth targets.
Strengthens client loyalty and account depth through consistent business development engagement, resulting in multi-year relationships and preferred-partner status.
Increases the firm's market share in target segments by establishing thought leadership and a reputation for solving the problems most relevant to prospective clients.

firm-contribution.description: Internal initiatives, knowledge sharing, community, and operations.

criteria.text: Drives measurable improvements in firm operations, processes, or employee experience — such as reduced time-to-staff, improved utilization, or higher onboarding satisfaction scores.
Produces reusable assets — frameworks, accelerators, templates, or toolkits — that are adopted by multiple teams and result in documented time or cost savings on engagements.
Increases participation or quality outcomes in firm programs (such as recruiting, learning, or community events) through direct ownership or sponsorship of those initiatives.
Shares expertise broadly through thought leadership content, internal publications, or enablement programs that reach practitioners across multiple markets or practice areas.
Engages external communities — professional associations, user groups, academic institutions — as a representative of the firm, expanding its visibility and talent pipeline.
Builds cross-practice relationships and communities of practice that connect practitioners with shared interests, facilitating knowledge transfer and peer learning at scale.
Champions internal initiatives that strengthen firm culture, capability, or community, visibly advocating for and investing personal time in programs that benefit the broader organization.
Models the values and behaviors the firm aspires to — inclusion, collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability — in all internal interactions and programs.
Takes on firm operational responsibilities (such as interviewing, performance calibration, or capacity planning) with diligence and consistency, even during demanding client engagements.
Aligns internal contributions with firm strategic priorities and transformation goals, focusing personal investment on programs and capabilities that matter most to the firm's future.
Connects firm contribution activities to talent strategy, ensuring that knowledge-sharing and community efforts support the recruitment, development, and retention of top practitioners.
Identifies capability gaps that limit the firm's competitiveness and proposes or leads initiatives to close those gaps through hiring, training, or asset development.
Creates lasting value for the firm through contributions that outlast any single engagement — durable frameworks, trained practitioners, strengthened communities, or improved processes.
Improves the firm's ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent through direct participation in recruiting, employer brand activities, or career development programs.
Contributes to a firm culture where practitioners feel valued, connected, and inspired to do their best work — evidenced by engagement, retention, and peer recognition outcomes.
